tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jigs byed kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ rol mo dang lhung lha'i bu rnams kyi ngag yin te ha cang mi bul ha cang mi myur lhung 'degs kyi ngag gis/ hūm̐ khyod ni dang po'i sangs rgyas te// chos kun sgrub gzhi'i dbyings nyid ka /rgyu yi rkyen gyis ma bslad pas// 'gro 'ong rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa min// ma rig dbyen zhugs rtags can la// rnam dbye gang dmigs der snang ba'i// chu zla'i sgrub byed 'dis na bdag /ma rungs 'dul phyir spyan 'dren gyi// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs pa yi// las kun mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor lha// 'phrin las dus bab yin dgongs nas// myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ hrīḥsogs/ sngon byas bag chags dbang gyur nas// da lta ngan 'gro'i las byed rnams// ma 'ongs bder bsgrub bsgral ba las// gzhan min 'khor bcas de ched bzhugs// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ji snyed par ni sprul gyur kyang*// ji lta ba las mi g.yo ba'i// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gzugs// 'jam dpal dpa' bor phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad dag par sbyangs zin pas// sku gsung thugs la rme ba ci// bdag nyid de lta bur 'dod nas// lha yi chu 'dis sku khrus gsol// oṃ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ sangs rgyas zhing na bsngags gyur cing*// 'jig rten mchog tu 'dzin pa yi// me tog bdug spos mar me byug /zhal zas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod// sngags/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs mchod rdzas las chus bsangs/ de dag ya ma me da k+ṣe/ de zhu bas gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang nga rgyal phrag dog dang de'i dbang gis nyes skyon bskyed pa thams cad yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par gyur/ yang dzas dor ru zhu ba las/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nang gi rdul rer bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgya mtshor mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho chos kyi sgra chen po grags pa/

tshul khrims kyi dri phun sum tshogs pa/ shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi zas te 'dod dgur sprul pa sha stag gis gang bar gyur/ oṃ a nut+ta ra sarba pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa mahā sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ hūm̐ byang chub yan lag me tog 'phreng*/ tshul khrims gtsang ma spos kyi dri// ma rig mun 'joms snang ba che// ting 'dzin dag pa bdud rtsi'i zas// mtshan dang dpe byad byug pa'i rtsi// chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgra bo ches// dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs mchod// sngags/ 'dod ldan mthong bas dga' 'gyur gzugs// sgra snyan yid 'ong sna tshogs kyang*// dri zhim spud pas tshim byed pa/ myang na zhi ba'i bcud 'dzin pa'i// bde sogs reg 'dzin lha mo rnams// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams la 'bul// drag po'i mchod rdzas rnams rā ṇa yo ni rats+tsha ni las 'od dang mi bzad pa'i sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yos/ pho nya dang mtshon cha'i char gyis gdug pa can thams cad kha btags te ro pho nya rnams kyis blangs te dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nang thams cad dur khrod chen po lta bur gyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas drag po'i las la 'jug pa la ji ltar dgyes pa de lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin chen por gyur/ hūm̐ dgra bo sogs brjod/ mdun bskyed la mtshan bstod/ bum bskyed la 'dud kyi bstod pa yang bya'o// cho ga'i 'gros ni bdag mdun bum gsum/ bdag 'jug de nas gzhan 'jug pa'o/// /sarba mad+ga laṃ/// /
